stations.title: Studio API
stations.text: Slow today, and restarting now and then.

captions: Sunniva keeps getting calls: people think the studio stopped running workshops.
The server was restarting, and the screen stayed blank without a word.
You add a loading line, an alert that says what went wrong, and Try again.
Now a restart shows the server's own reason, with a button to ask again.
Slow, broken or offline, the visitor always knows what is going on.
